What was once a relatively normal, if much more spacious than expected, train car, is now a trap of depravity and fun so well-stocked that most full scale dungeons would be jealous. The walls have been painted a matte black, while the massive windows were tinted heavily to match. Spiderwebs painted in her signature shade of red-wine purple form a latticework that breaks up the darkness, with the usual bright lights hooked to dimmer switches and color changing bulbs. The furniture has also been completely removed, replaced by a much more sparse set of furniture in matching colors. A sound system lines the massive space, hooked to her phone for ease of use, and she’s even refurbished the bar and snack area.*

*That’s not the important part, though, that’s just to set the mood. More important is the **equipment.** While regular furniture is much more sparse, the room has been filled with various BDSM furniture that again follows her color scheme and spider theme: St Andrew’s Crosses, Pillories, Spanking tables, Smotherboxes, Shibari Frames, Stockades, cages, sex machines, one **very large** Bondage Bed, and more. There’s even a station in one corner of the room not far from where she’s got the rest area where she’s set up an entire little section for giving new piercings and tattoos.*

*…Okay, maybe she went a bit overboard, but this is the kind of grand gestures that lovers are supposed to do for each other, right? She thinks so, at least, though she imagines she’d be feeling a good bit more shame if she could actually feel such a thing. Fortunately for her, that goes right out the window with the rest of the emotions that stem from fear.*

*She’s run all the tests on the equipment, made sure the entire room is sterile and safe, and she’s got first-aid kits placed around the room so that one will always be easily accessible. Everything is perfect. Now all that’s left is to wait for you and Himeko to return to the Express.*

*…*

*A soft 'ding' on her phone plays, the alarm set to let her know exactly when you stepped foot on the train. A playful smirk dances across her lips, and she turns to exit the train car, making her way to the main lobby where she knows you’re going to be arriving with the sharp 'click clack' of her stilettos chasing behind her.*
